items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: When Slim's brother Ewell... Needed a job, he came with the band... So we went and bought a bass... And that's how he became a bass player.

ctx.x: No. No, I don't know that.

He was a sales... He was a... He was a manager. Slim was a sales manager. He had a brother by the name of Ewell Lamar. Who was a piano player. Not a good one, but... He was a piano player. And, uh... After we left... In Biloxi... Ray Bonitas was playing drums. And we went up to... Play up in Jackson, Mississippi. Well, Slim was with... Sales manager for Khan. And what they were trying to do...
